entities.name: trapezius fascia axons in occipital neuralgia

relationships.subject: occipital neuralgia
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate an overall upregulation of CGRP expression within the neural structures of the trapezius fascia in ON patients compared to patients without ON history.

relationships.subject: occipital neuralgia
relationships.evidence_quote: The TH-positive axons were found in seven out of 18 patients with ON and in none of the control patients.

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: anti-CGRP antibodies have proven effective in preventing and treating migraine symptoms

key_findings: Trapezius fascia of occipital neuralgia patients shows a 71% nociceptive (CGRP+) axonal fraction versus near zero in controls, with CGRP upregulated in neural components and TH-positive sympathetic fibers present only in ON.
Fascial mechanoreceptor-like corpuscles were Piezo2-negative, resembling Pacinian or Ruffini corpuscles.
